responsibility: Defines the main RTL expansion interface used by GCC’s auto-vectorizers for RVV. It supplies target expands for masked length-based loads, stores, gathers, scatters, strided accesses, truncation and extension helpers, vector compares and branches, early-break mask formation, and other autovectorization primitives, delegating to riscv_vector expansion routines to turn middle-end len/mask operations into legal RVV code before later optimization passes refine them.
